faults.title: Water entering the boot
faults.description: On the first-generation Aygo, water can enter around the rear window or lamps and leave the boot damp. Check for staining or moisture and repair the leak path before drying the trim.

faults.title: Water-pump coolant leak
faults.description: Coolant can escape from the Mk1 Aygo's water pump. Check for falling coolant level or visible leaks and have the cooling system repaired before the engine overheats.
